title: India’s largest earthquake-isolated hospital block coming up at LD Hospital

ai.summary: A six-storey hospital block in Srinagar, Kashmir, designed with advanced seismic base-isolation technology to withstand earthquakes is nearing completion under the World Bank-funded Jhelum and Tawi Flood Recovery Project.

facts.claim: The six-storey structure at Lal Ded Hospital Srinagar incorporates advanced seismic base-isolation technology
facts.quote: This building is designed to move with the earthquakes.

facts.claim: The building incorporates 43 friction pendulum isolators
facts.quote: The building incorporates 43 friction pendulum isolators.

facts.claim: The LD Hospital project is the largest among three such base-isolation projects in India
facts.quote: The LD Hospital project is the largest among three such base-isolation projects in India.

facts.claim: The base-isolation system is the key and differentiating feature of the building's structural design
facts.quote: The base-isolation system is the key and differentiating feature of the building's structural design.

facts.claim: Dr Jan said the building can bear a quake upto the intensity of 8 Richter scale
facts.quote: Dr Jan said the building can bear a quake upto the intensity of 8 Richter scale.

facts.claim: The original allotted cost of Rs 118.22 crore has been revised to Rs 127.75 crore now
facts.quote: The original allotted cost of Rs 118.22 crore has been revised to Rs 127.75 crore now.

facts.claim: The G+5 structure with an attic has a total built-up area of 11,640 square metres
facts.quote: The G+5 structure with an attic has a total built-up area of 11,640 square metres.

facts.claim: The block will house specialties of gynae-oncology and assisted fertility and will house specialised healthcare infrastructure
facts.quote: The block will house specialties of gynae-oncology and assisted fertility and will house specialised healthcare infrastructure.
